approved_tools.name: Marks at the Gate
approved_tools.purpose: The child makes one mark for each cow that leaves the gate and strikes one out for each cow that comes back, then sees whether any cow is missing.

approved_tools.name: Marks for a Big Herd
approved_tools.purpose: The child strikes out one mark for each cow that comes home, reads the marks left to find the cows still out and the cows back, then makes separate marks for cows and sheep.

approved_tools.name: Longest and Shortest Name
approved_tools.purpose: The child counts the letters of each name and picks the longest and the shortest name, for the animal cards, for Mahesh and Kartik, and for friends' names.

approved_tools.name: Starting and Ending Letters
approved_tools.purpose: The child drops name tags into piles by their starting letter or by their ending letter and counts each pile to see which letter is used most.

approved_tools.name: Build a Number Name
approved_tools.purpose: The child lays a tens card and a ones card together to make a number name, as Teji does for 43, and counts its letters.

approved_tools.name: Number Name Puzzles
approved_tools.purpose: The child finds numbers between 1 and 99 from clues about the letters in their names (8 letters, the longest name, the riddles) and notices what same-count names share.

approved_tools.name: Group the Cards Two Ways
approved_tools.purpose: The child drags cards into two groups by a rule, finds the rule in Jojo's groups, then regroups the same cards another way so every card is in one group.
approved_tools.flow_row: Group the cards two ways (C10, C11)
